answer: Stakes are slashed if collusion is detected, and reputation flows only through verified work like a nebula's slow glow, while honest agents cluster on a trusted reef of peers that vouch for real activity. Each agent must stake tokens at the harbor registry to unlock voting; a sybil attacker splitting into many identities must post a separate stake per alias, so the cost scales linearly with the swarm size and quickly exceeds any reward. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
